headline: Your To-Let poster,
now with a QR.
posts.caption: Naya SPoT update: apni published property se ek tap mein QR wala To-Let poster banayein. Koi bhi raah chalta phone camera se scan kare aur seedha aapki listing dekhe — photos, rent aur details ke saath. A4 par print karein ya WhatsApp par share karein.

headline: Gate par lagayein,
address chhupayein.
posts.subline: QR-only poster for your own gate
posts.caption: Apne ghar ke gate ke liye 'QR only' poster chunein — poster par rent aur address nahi chhapta, bas TO-LET aur bada QR. Jo scan kare, wahi aapki published listing dekhe. Hindi, English ya dono bhashaon mein.

headline: Printed To-Let board,
₹999 cash on delivery.
posts.caption: Print karwane ka jhanjhat nahi? SPoT app se apne QR poster ka mazboot, weather-resistant To-Let board order karein — ₹999 mein delivery shamil, payment delivery par cash mein. Printing se pehle hum call karke confirm karte hain.

headline: Generate. Print.
Stick it up.
posts.caption: 3 steps mein To-Let poster: 1) SPoT app mein apni published property kholein. 2) 'Generate QR poster' dabayein aur layout, colour aur bhasha chunein. 3) A4 par 100% size mein print karke gate ke paas aankhon ki unchai par lagayein.

headline: Photocopy wala poster,
phir bhi scan hoga.
posts.caption: Sasta print chahiye? QR poster ka Black & White option chunein — colour fills hat jaate hain, photocopy mein bhi QR saaf aata hai. Poster par aapka phone number ya pura address kabhi nahi chhapta.

headline: Board order kiya?
Status app mein dekho.
posts.caption: Printed board order karne ke baad 'My board orders' mein har step dekhein — accepted, printing, shipped, delivered. Printing shuru hone tak order free mein cancel kar sakte hain. Board ₹999, cash on delivery.

headline: Ab SPoT pe ghar
bechein bhi.
posts.subline: Rent ke saath ab Buy & Sell
posts.caption: Naya SPoT update: ab sirf rent nahi, property bechna aur kharidna bhi. Ghar, flat, dukaan, plot ya zameen, sab SPoT par list karein. Wahi app jismein aap apne rentals manage karte hain, ab usmein naya Buy tab bhi hai. Owners, agents aur dealers, sab welcome.

headline: Kharidna hai?
Seedhe maalik se.
posts.caption: Property kharidni hai? SPoT ka Buy tab kholein, apna sheher chunein aur house, flat, shop, plot ya land ke hisaab se filter karein. Budget set karein, sirf direct owners dekhein, aur ₹ per sq ft se compare karein. Agent listings par Broker label hota hai.

headline: 5 steps mein listing,
AI likhega description.
posts.caption: Property bechni hai? 5 steps mein listing banayein: type, price, area, details aur photos. Description likhne ka mann nahi? AI draft bana deta hai, aap padhkar edit karein. Har listing aur photo live hone se pehle check hoti hai, aksar kuch minute mein.

headline: Pehle chat,
phir site visit.
posts.caption: Listing pasand aayi? Pehle Chat dabayein aur Inbox mein seller se sawaal poochein. Phir site visit book karein: 3 tak time suggest karein, owner ek confirm karega, aur dono ko visit se 2 ghante pehle reminder milega.

headline: Aapka number,
aapki marzi.
posts.subline: Sirf chune hue buyers ko share
posts.caption: Seller ho? Aapka phone number listing par public nahi hota. Har buyer inquiry app mein dekhein, aur number sirf unhi buyers ke saath share karein jinse aap baat karna chahte hain. Baaki baat chat mein hi chalti rahe.

headline: Verify karein,
phir payment.
posts.caption: Property kharidne se pehle: papers khud verify karein, site par jaakar dekhein, aur token ya advance tabhi dein jab sab clear ho. SPoT buyers aur sellers ko jodta hai, ownership verify nahi karta aur payment handle nahi karta. Galat listing dikhe toh app mein Report karein.
